sum: Star Fashion Culture Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides content marketing solutions services in the People's Republic of China. The company offers marketing campaign planning and execution, including event design, logistics, layout of events, materials preparation, actual event set-up, and implementation; offline advertising services, which include the designing and arranging for display of offline marketing materials on bus lines; online precision marketing services, such as the designing and integrating of advertisements, marketing of materials, and promotion of videos into online video and social medial platforms; and event hosting services. It distributes its products through a network of third-party suppliers. The company serves consumer goods, advertising and marketing, and media industries. Star Fashion Culture Holdings Limited was founded in 2015 and is based in Xiamen, the People's Republic of China.
